publication.edition: Greek text with introduction and commentary

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed the treatise is a Roman-era Greek work conventionally dated to the 1st century CE, author uncertain ('Pseudo-Longinus'); Russell 1964 is the standard Anglophone commentary. Used for the theory of elevated thought and figured composition that underlies the philosophical voice's grandeur.

limitations: Claims about Greek rhythm and figures rest on the Greek; the tone card must not assert acoustic specifics from translation alone.

copyright.notes: Treatise public domain; Russell edition copyrighted; no passages reproduced.
